title: Chat 'Save this workspace as Collector's Daily Briefing and reopen last week's version' saves nothing and shows unrelated counts
what_happens: The answer is '1,262 reported, 1,109 still open, 325 past deadline'. Nothing is saved: Menu > Workspaces still says 'No saved workspaces yet'. No sentence says it was not saved.
what_should_happen: Save the view and say so, or say plainly that chat cannot save and point to Menu > Workspaces.
root_cause_guess: unknown: no save intent in the assistant router
skeptic_why: Reproduced on :3193 via POST /api/collector/assistant/chat: the save sentence returns a plain KPI answer (1,260 reported, 1,109 open, 325 past deadline) with no save and no note. Counts are 7-day, unrelated to a save. Did not re-check the Workspaces menu.

title: 'Show every source and application record used to create this briefing' returns headline KPIs, not a source list
what_happens: Answer is '588 severe events, 1,238 open citizen complaints, 2,412 ongoing incidents'. No source or record is listed.
what_should_happen: List the sources and records behind the briefing, or open the source panel.
skeptic_why: Reproduced via chat API: headline is KPIs (587 severe, 1,238 open complaints, 2,412 ongoing) with a zones chart; no sources or records listed.

title: 'List the taluks with the highest number of unresolved incidents last month' returns one total and no taluks
what_happens: Answer is '2,067 incidents still open, last 30 days', with Reported 2,067 and Still open 2,067 (every reported one still open) and '+737% vs previous'. No taluk is named.
what_should_happen: A ranked list of taluks with counts.
skeptic_why: Reproduced via chat API: one KPI answer (2,067 open, last 30 days), scope.taluk null, no taluk list. Note Reported equals Still open (2,067), which looks odd but was not dug into.

title: The brief's own query 'incidents reported by more than one newspaper but missing from the departmental application' is answered as 'Missing person in the news'
what_happens: The top Search / Ask the map panel shows a chip 'Missing person · In the news' and '5 missing person incidents in the news'. The same sentence in the Ctrl K panel gets a different answer (news-only stories). A confident answer about the wrong thing.
what_should_happen: Same sentence, same meaning in both panels: news-only incidents carried by several outlets.
root_cause_guess: the word 'missing' matched the missing-person category
skeptic_why: Reproduced via POST /api/map/ask: the sentence gives a plan with category MISSING_PERSON plus news:true, so the word missing was read as the category. The same sentence without the missing clause gives category null. Chat API answers it correctly (31 in the news, no department record). Severity P0 kept as a confident wrong answer; arguably P1 since the chip shows the wrong filter openly.

title: Briefing says today is 'about the same' as the previous period; the Overview says 133 fewer ongoing incidents and 15 fewer severe
what_happens: Briefing key point 1: 'Today saw about the same number of incidents as the previous period.' Overview daily tiles: Ongoing 95, 133 fewer than yesterday; Severe 1, 15 fewer.
what_should_happen: The same comparison in both places.

title: Wrong categories and a wrong place on news stories shown to the Collector
what_happens: 'Newborn girl found abandoned in Neelankarai' is filed under Flood relief needs and District Disaster Management. 'Chennai police tighten security for Diwali' is filed under Crimes against women and children. 'Two killed in accidents in Poonamallee and Kelambakkam' is placed at Vadapalani. The CM story summary ends 'Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C.'
what_should_happen: Right category and place, or an unresolved flag.
root_cause_guess: district_intel pipeline data: report only, do not patch
skeptic_why: Partly reproduced via /api/collector/search: Newborn girl story is Flood relief needs under District Disaster Management; Poonamallee/Kelambakkam accident is at Vadapalani. Diwali security and CM summary truncation not reproduced (search did not return them). Pipeline data: report only.

title: Server log shows the embedding model failing to load, repeatedly
what_happens: Log lines '[assistant] embedding index: Load model ... multilingual-e5-base/onnx/model_quantized.onnx failed: Protobuf parsing failed' repeat. Meaning-based search is then off, which may be why journey-judge-4 happens. It may be only this worktree's model cache file; I did not check its size.
what_should_happen: Model loads, or the app says plainly that it runs on rules only.
root_cause_guess: truncated or placeholder model file in .cache/models

title: With --frozen the Collector page never opens
what_happens: Pages redirect to /login?redirect=/collector and the login shows 'Opening your console' forever, though /api calls work with the same cookie (curl: /api/auth/me 200, /collector 307). The token is signed with the frozen clock; the page guard checks it against the real clock, so the 12 h session is already expired. Not a product bug. I ran without --frozen as a result. Also 127.0.0.1 redirects to localhost and is then blocked by the security policy.
what_should_happen: Frozen runs should allow page walks.
repro: node tests/qa/pass4/server.mjs start --port 3180 --frozen --ticking --instance judge, then sign in at http://localhost:3180/login
